text:
Maya R: Quick sync — we're cutting the release tomorrow 18:00 PT. Need coordinated version bumps across repo surface: api, runtime, console, js-sdk. Who's owning which?

Jonas: I merged API bump PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/123). Tag `v0.15.0` ready on my end. Console still needs to update client deps.

Samir: Runtime bump is blocked by a perf regression on aarch64 tests — reproducing locally now. I have a fix branch but want CI to confirm before tagging. PR coming in ~30m.

Carla: Changelog reminder: please add a short migration note for the SDK changes (breaking: client ctor signature). I'll curate the changelog bullets once PRs land.

Kevin: Heads up — cutoff for published tags is in 6h. Please pin SHAs and avoid non-critical changes after that. @release-bot, can you schedule a 2h-before reminder? :alarm_clock:

release-bot: Reminder scheduled — cutoff at 18:00 PT (in 6h). Will post again at 2h and 30m before cutoff.

Lu: JS SDK bump is ready locally but needs updated types. I'll open the PR to update `packages/console/package.json` to reference new SDK version once Jonas confirms console can intake it.

Maya R: Proposed timeline: by EOD today — API merged & tagged, runtime PR green and tagged, console PR open updating deps (or at least draft), SDK PR merged or open. If anything slips >1h, ping here.

Jonas: Console PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/456 — contains dep update to `@redwood/sdk@0.9.0-beta` and minor build fix. Need at least one approval.

Samir: Pushed runtime fix, perf tests passing locally. CI started. If green I'll tag `runtime:v0.15.0` and post the tag/sha here.

Carla: Drafting changelog now, adding this bullet: "Improved KV cache consistency and client constructor API changes — see SDK migration note." Will link PRs when available.

Kevin: Also add a short rollback section in the release playbook for mismatched console/sdk versions (how to pin older sdk in console and rollback tag).

Maya R: small checklist (copy/paste into PRs):
```
- [ ] API: tag v0.15.0 and push release notes (owner: Jonas)
- [ ] Runtime: PR green + tag (owner: Samir)
- [ ] Console: dep update PR open and reviewed (owner: Jonas/Lu)
- [ ] JS SDK: merge bump + typings (owner: Lu)
- [ ] Changelog: add migration note (owner: Carla)
- [ ] Confirm final tags and SHAs here before cutoff
```

Jonas: Reviewing console CI now. Will request review from @Lu and @Carla.

Samir: CI is green. Tagged runtime at `runtime@v0.15.0` (sha: `a1b2c3d`). Posting changelog PR in a minute.

Carla: Thanks — added changelog entry and linked PRs. Draft: "runtime v0.15.0 — KV cache improvements; API v0.15.0 — client timeout default changed; SDK v0.9.0 — constructor signature updated". I'll refine wording after merges.

Kevin: Excellent. I'll update the playbook with rollback steps and pin commands.

Maya R: Great work team. If no objections we'll freeze non-critical merges at cutoff. Ping here if you need a quick hand reviewing. :thumbsup:
